name: Homepage renders the personal site hero and all sections
description: The deployed NES.css personal site loads at mobin-zaman.github.io, shows the owner's name in the hero, and renders the work/bands/contact sections with the Shohojia band linking to Facebook.

planSteps.description: The hero headline displays the name 'Mohetuzzaman' and 'Mobin'
A section titled 'What I do' is visible with list items for Software development, Consulting, and Music
A section titled 'The bands' is visible and lists both Shohojia and Urban Genesis
The Shohojia link in the bands section points to the official Shohojia Facebook page (facebook.com/shohojia)
A Contact section is visible listing an email address, a GitHub link, and a GitLab link
The page does not scroll horizontally (no overflowing content on a standard desktop viewport)
